name: CA-38
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's 8-point Democratic lean plus a favorable national environment
Solis's large fundraising edge and outside support versus a low-profile Republican
Prediction markets price Democratic win odds near 97%
No polling or expert ratings, so fundamentals carry the forecast
model.rationale: The post-redistricting seat leans Democratic by 8 points and the political environment adds roughly 9 more, while Hilda Solis has raised $1.4 million with outside backing and no opposition spending against her. Markets price her near certain, and Pedro Casas shows no measurable financial footprint, so the race stays safely Democratic.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Casas gaining traction, or a surge of outside spending against Solis, would be the first sign the margin is narrowing.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; fundamentals point clearly one way (post-redistricting), so it is treated as safe for that party.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's 38th district is an open seat after redistricting, and Democrats enter with a clear structural advantage. The district leans Democratic by about 8 points, and the current national environment adds several more points on top of that. Hilda Solis, a well-known local official, has raised about $1.4 million and holds a cash advantage, with outside groups supporting her and none opposing.

Republican Pedro Casas has reported little or no fundraising and has drawn no outside spending, and no public polls or expert ratings cover the race. Prediction markets put Democratic odds near 97%. The forecast calls the seat Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty coming from the absence of direct polling rather than any observed weakness for Solis.
